# FG-AUTH-0021

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_confidential_item_is_withheld_from_an_agent` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この項目は機密の印が付いているため、AI エージェントのトークンには渡しません。人のアカウントで開いてください。
- en: This item is marked confidential and is not given to an AI agent's token. Open it with a person's account.
- id: Item ini ditandai rahasia dan tidak diberikan kepada token agen AI. Buka dengan akun orang.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 06 D-5 (M3 X5, ADR-0023 Amendment X5): what is marked confidential is never handed to an AI agent by the context API. The caller was allowed to read the project (ContextRead / MergeRequestRead decided it), but it is an agent audience — a token issued with `is_agent`, a service account or a bot (`Principal::is_agent_audience`), or the request said `Forge-Context-Audience: agent` (gstn mcp always does) — and the one item asked for is marked: a work item with `forge.work_items.confidential`, or a requirement whose specification document has `confidential: true` in its front matter (or a front matter that cannot be read: the mark may be in it, so it fails closed). The repository read routes (blob, raw, blame) refuse a file confidential at the revision read or at the default branch's tip by one rule (`forge_checks::confidential`, `reason=spec_confidential` with `path`): a specification document marked as above, or any `.md` whose `classification` (or older `confidential`; both written fails closed) is `confidential`, with its type's default from `.forge/doctypes/<type>.yml` as a floor (a type that cannot be read, a front matter that cannot be read, a document not read because of a bound, or no default branch born: confidential). The document API (plan 13 stage 3) answers such a document as an absent one instead (FG-REPO-0005 `reason=doc_confidential`, no existence oracle). Lists and diffs (the spec API, a merge request's context, compare, a commit, a merge request's diffs) leave such items out and count them in `withheld` instead of refusing (the document list leaves them out without a count). Not a fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `route`, `project_id`, `reason` (`work_item_confidential` or `spec_confidential`), `audience` (`agent_token`, `service_account`, `bot` or `header`) and, by reason, `work_item` or `requirement` and `path`. Read the mark: the document's front matter (gstn browse blob --project <id> --ref <rev> --path <path>), or SELECT confidential FROM forge.work_items WHERE ref = '<PBI-n>'.

## 対処 (fix)

Expected for an AI agent: a person reads the item with their own session or a token without `is_agent`. If the mark is wrong, correct it where it is set (the document's front matter; the work item's mark comes from kanflow). A front matter that cannot be read is fixed by fixing it (forge/spec-lint names the rule).
